column1: #Text=Can you describe the content of this map?
#Text=There are major roads, a green dotted line that probably represents a greenway, a bike path.
#Text=There is an airport nearby and not far from the marshes.
#Text=Represented by the dotted area on the estuary, there may be sand.
#Text=The roads are probably departmental or municipal roads; there are no major roads.
#Text=This map probably shows the suburbs of Saint-Nazaire.
